memoryNotes: Windows PSAPI WorkingSetSize is resident working set; PrivateUsage is private commit, not RSS or VRAM.
Native harness samples every 20ms; Viewer observation every 100ms. Sampled peaks are lower bounds, not exact instantaneous peaks.
lifetimePeakWorkingSetBytes is an OS lifetime counter, not a peak for an individual Region.
StageCache CPU/GPU/retained bytes and sourceHost/sourceCache bytes are separate Native ownership metrics; do not sum overlapping ownership.
Base64 character counts and PNG lengths are logical sizes, not measured Browser Blob or decoder allocations.
Native document-close sample belonged to a retiring process; the replacement idle process working set was 8642560 bytes, private commit 1953792 bytes.
Backend vs Python launcher roles were checked by process parent links; no process IDs or command lines are retained.
limitations: Native benchmark: one fresh process for each CPU/DX12 and cache OFF/ON combination; no statistical repetition.
The controlled Native matrix holds Whole at 2048 and does not execute the Viewer scheduler; policy calculations are not UI acceptance.
Controlled view labels use CSS scale; Viewer display Zoom is scale times DPR times 100.
Early Frontend log overflow lost first-1to1 and early automated Pan logs. These sessions remain explicitly incomplete; cold-1to1-recapture and Pan recaptures replace them.
Human Pan suffix is complete: its first view precedes retained suffix end, and generations are contiguous; total export drop counters remain visible.
Human gesture lasted 7984ms, longer than the requested 1-2s; do not relabel it as a 2s result.
Viewer action timings include input injection overhead; view-event timings use Frontend event timestamps.
UI trace uses DPR 1, 672x577 viewport; maximum Fit viewport 1952x1096 was also observed. Large viewport partial Pan has synthetic and Native matrix evidence, not a new human acceptance.
No observed threshold wobble: density-only candidates gave the same transition count. Boundary quality judgments remain for Windows acceptance.
Quantization changes were 7 vs 7 on this coarse trace; fine zoom/source-level counterfactuals were not measured.
No Dehaze UI or NR/sharpening changes; existing Native Dehaze regression is retained, not newly rerun.
No telemetry, private source identities, raw paths, settings bodies, screenshots, HTTP headers or log exports are included.
